primary_exact_labeled_sampler.state_representation: naturally birth-labeled transitive-closure bit rows; the new vertex is maximal
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.transition_domain: all down-set precursors of the current labeled relation
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.selection_distribution: exact probability proportional to w(P) over labeled down-sets
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.selection_arithmetic: integer ticket over exact rational weights
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.weight_integerization: take the least common denominator of the enumerated exact rational weights, scale to positive integers, divide their common gcd, and use cumulative tickets in branch_order

portable_rng.coordinate_encoding: sampling_seed, trajectory_index, growth_step, ticket_index, rejection_attempt, and block_index are unsigned 64-bit big-endian integers appended in that order
portable_rng.digest_consumption: concatenate blocks in ascending block_index and take the first k bytes as one big-endian integer
portable_rng.unbiased_ticket_rule: for total integer weight M>0 set k=max(1,ceil(bit_length(M)/8)), R=256^k, cutoff=R-(R mod M); accept x<cutoff and return x mod M, otherwise increment rejection_attempt
portable_rng.overflow_rule: any coordinate outside uint64 or any nonpositive M fails closed

primary_exact_labeled_sampler.unlabeled_quotient_argument: automorphism-related down-sets have equal local weight; summing labeled choices over an orbit gives orbit_size*w(P), exactly the multiplicity factor in the frozen unlabeled instrument
forbidden_on_large_n_path: enumerate every unlabeled poset at a level
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.worst_case_boundary: the number of down-sets can be 2^n, so exact transition enumeration is not certified to reach n=60
primary_exact_labeled_sampler.overflow_behavior: fail closed with DOWNSET_ENUMERATION_LIMIT; no approximate fallback

large_n_observable_extension.height_replacement: exact longest-path dynamic program on a topological order of the transitive relation, checked against the exhaustive oracle through n=5
large_n_observable_extension.current_width_boundary: causal_sets.width also enumerates all 2^n subsets and is forbidden on the large-N path; width is not a required continuum-dimension estimator
large_n_observable_extension.optional_width_promotion_rule: if width is later reported, use a separately tested Dilworth bipartite-matching implementation and match the exhaustive oracle through n=5
large_n_observable_extension.relation_identity: SHA-256 digest of a frozen natural-label transitive-row wire encoding; it is a labeled trajectory digest, not an unlabeled isomorphism identifier
large_n_observable_extension.spectral_cost_boundary: the exact Fraction dense-matrix walk is a bounded arithmetic oracle only; the production numerical path, tolerance audit, cached Hasse adjacency, and cost must pass the implementation preflight

approximate_weighted_ideal_route.candidate_method: reversible weighted-ideal Markov chain or sequential importance sampler
approximate_weighted_ideal_route.missing_certificate: no uniform mixing, bias, or effective-sample-size guarantee has been established for the frozen nonlocal diamond weight
approximate_weighted_ideal_route.promotion_rule: must receive a separate design, validation artifact, and owner-approved budget before it can replace exact integer-ticket selection

independent_replay_design.small_n_oracle: existing brute-force masks and frozen unlabeled transition instrument through n=5
independent_replay_design.second_large_n_implementation: frontier-antichain order-ideal iterator with no calls to the primary generator
independent_replay_design.shared_surface: serialized relation rows, frozen fugacities, counter-stream seed, and artifact schema only; down-set generation, local-statistic deltas, normalization, and ticket selection are independently implemented
required_comparisons: exact transition normalizers and branch probabilities through n=5
all relabelings through the bounded exact oracle domain
trajectory digests for every bounded implementation-preflight seed
relation and observable digests for preregistered large-N replay chunks before any production authorization
independent_replay_design.failure_rule: any discrepancy blocks artifact promotion; no retry with a replacement seed

geometric_dimension_control.construction: fixed-cardinality uniform sprinklings in a supplied four-dimensional Minkowski Alexandrov interval
geometric_dimension_control.purpose: end-to-end recovery check for the dimension-measurement pipeline with dimension four supplied

bdg_action_evaluation_control.purpose: evaluate supplied dimension-four BDG coefficients and nonlocality scale on independently replayed geometric controls

required_before_that_name_is_used: dimension-four action coefficients and nonlocality scale

positive_control_extension.promotion_boundary: the geometric control must replay independently before BDG action evaluation; neither control is candidate emergence evidence

spectral_protocol_extension.freeze_source: positive and negative controls only, before candidate production measurements are opened
selection_algorithm_obligations: use the registered lazy symmetrized Hasse walk and isolated-vertex convention
require at least four local-slope points and a minimum log-time span
exclude finite-size saturation using the component return floor
require positive local slopes and a preregistered plateau-dispersion bound
choose the longest eligible log-span and break ties by the earliest window
freeze all numerical thresholds on control training data only and validate without refit on control holdout data
required_diagnostics: window stability across held-out control seeds
spectral_protocol_extension.failure_rule: no independently validated stable window means no spectral-dimension estimator; retain only an exploratory graph-diffusion diagnostic

statistical_protocol_extension.sampling_unit: per-seed batch estimate; trajectories are never pooled across seeds
statistical_protocol_extension.seed_count_rule: determine and freeze training and holdout seed counts by control-only precision and coverage simulation before candidate access
statistical_protocol_extension.negative_control_rule_required: use preregistered simultaneous interval separation from an equivalence band for at least two defined estimators; undefined estimators never count as separation
failure_rules: a negative control satisfying the candidate pattern stops promotion
an interval touching the equivalence band is INCONCLUSIVE
excess undefined bootstrap mass stops promotion
control failure cannot be repaired by adding seeds or retuning thresholds after holdout inspection

resource_supervision_design.execution_model: worker subprocess supervised by a parent process
resource_supervision_design.promotion_protocol: write to a temporary directory and atomically promote only after schema, digest, and replay validation
resource_supervision_design.retry_policy: zero retries; timeout or OOM is not replaced by another seed

proposed_scope_without_values: bounded labeled-sampler cost probe above n=5
exact dynamic-programming height equivalence and full observable cost probe
hard-supervisor process-tree kill, memory-limit, and partial-artifact tests
acceptance_requirements: large-N module does not call unlabeled-level enumeration or factorial canonicalization
large-N height does not call exhaustive subset enumeration and matches the n<=5 oracle
production spectral numerical path matches the bounded exact oracle within a preregistered tolerance
no scientific verdict or production authorization is added

stop_conditions: exact down-set enumeration reaches its approved cap
any production observable reaches an unapproved exponential or dense-exact arithmetic path
hard resource supervisor fails to terminate a fixture
positive control or spectral-window freeze remains unavailable
statistical interval method, seed count, or negative-control equivalence rule remains unfrozen
any candidate coefficient is changed or fitted

claim_boundary.maximum_future_finite_size_wording_after: finite-size N=8...60 behavior is consistent with preregistered diagnostics and controls
